name: Voise AdServer
seoTitle: Voise AdServer: Omnichannel Ad Server for OpenRTB, Video, CTV & DOOH | Voise Tech
description: Voise AdServer is VoiseTech’s core platform: one omnichannel ad server for OpenRTB, video and CTV, DOOH and reporting, built on Rust, Kafka and ClickHouse.
tagline: One Omnichannel Ad Server. Every Surface on One Engine.
intro: Voise AdServer is VoiseTech’s core technology: one ad server and bidder engine for programmatic OpenRTB, video and CTV, digital out-of-home and reporting. Publishers, ad units, demand partners and line items are set up once, in one place, and every surface we build runs on the same infrastructure.
Voise SSP, Pre-Bid and our buyer-side products are being brought onto the same engine, so supply, demand and reporting share one data model instead of a chain of disconnected tools.

edge.title: OpenRTB & programmatic
edge.text: RTB ad units with OpenRTB 2.5 and 2.6 endpoints. Demand partners are integrated once; your team runs line items for open auction, PMP and programmatic guaranteed, with deal IDs carried end to end.

edge.title: Voise Video SDK
edge.text: Video and CTV beyond a player: VAST ad units, Google IMA and PAL integrations, multiple ad formats around publisher content, and player telemetry that feeds the same reporting.

edge.title: DOOH
edge.text: Two sides on one infrastructure: a supply-side CMS for screen owners to manage content and ad slots, and a Planning Tool for agencies to plan out-of-home campaigns.

edge.title: Reporting
edge.text: One model from ad request to paid impression: requests, bids, responses, wins, impressions, revenue and eCPM, with an hourly view of today and a reporting API per ad unit.

integrations.label: Publisher
integrations.text: Onboard a publisher once: domain, seller details for sellers.json, default revenue share, and the team members who can see the account.

integrations.label: Ad unit
integrations.text: Every ad unit belongs to one publisher and has a type (RTB, VAST or banner), an ad format, and a platform: web, in-app, CTV or DOOH.

integrations.label: Demand partner
integrations.text: Our engineering team integrates each demand partner once, through an OpenRTB endpoint, a VAST tag or a JavaScript tag.

integrations.label: Line item
integrations.text: Your team maps line items to ad units, with pricing, targeting, caps and traffic-quality rules, and can edit the mapping from either side.

items.label: Revenue models
items.text: revenue share, floor plus margin, or fixed price, set per ad unit.

items.label: Price gates
items.text: minimum and maximum eCPM, and a ceiling on the floor sent to demand.

items.label: Snapshots
items.text: each impression keeps the pricing that applied when it won, so later changes never rewrite history.

items.label: sellers.json
items.text: the seller ID published for each publisher is the one sent in every bid request.

items.label: SupplyChain object
items.text: schain nodes built per publisher, with seller pass-through when the relationship calls for it.

items.label: Inventory partner domain
items.text: IPD signalling when VoiseTech acts as an inventory partner.

items.label: Deals
items.text: PMP and PG deal objects passed to demand and deal IDs echoed back for reconciliation.

items.label: Categories
items.text: IAB content categories, blocked ad categories (BCAT) and blocked creative attributes (BATTR).

items.label: Lists
items.text: domain, brand, app, seat ID and creative ID lists, managed centrally and uploaded by CSV.

items.label: Precedence
items.text: a block always wins over an allow.

items.label: Pre-bid & post-bid
items.text: invalid-traffic scanning before the auction and on delivered impressions.

items.label: Per ad unit
items.text: vendor, sampling rate and enforcement set for each ad unit.

items.label: Win and billing signals
items.text: NURL, BURL and ad-markup tracking supported.

items.label: Fewer discrepancies
items.text: the signal each publisher reconciles on is the one we guarantee to send.

items.label: VAST ad units
items.text: URL templates with standard player parameters: size, start delay, duration, linearity, device and app identifiers.

items.label: Server-side ad insertion
items.text: SSAI support with server-side tracking for stitched CTV streams.

items.label: Caps
items.text: daily request and impression caps per ad unit, with blocking at the edge when traffic must stop.

items.label: Roles
items.text: account managers see only the publishers assigned to them; publishers get their own reporting login.

techTitle: A Streaming Architecture, End to End.
techIntro: Decisioning services emit every event to a stream; reporting reads from a columnar store. Configuration and serving data live in purpose-built stores.
